text:
Amanda: Heads-up — small docs policy change about SDK code snippets' execution timeouts. Please read before merging snippet PRs.

Jon: What exactly is changing?

Amanda: Default timeout for inline code snippets in our public docs is being reduced from 30s to 5s. Rationale: long-running snippets frequently cause CI flakiness and block docs merges. This only affects inline examples (not sample apps).

Kai: Only inline docs? What about the runnable playground examples we host?

Amanda: Good question. Playground and runnable sample apps are exempt for now — they'll keep the current timeout. We'll add explicit notes in those repos. The 5s rule is for static docs snippets that get executed by the snippet-checker in CI.

docs-bot: Note: snippet-checker job now enforces --snippet-timeout=5s for docs/* paths. Failing snippets will block the docs CI job. See: https://go.redwood/ci-snippet-checker :robot_face:

Lina: I'll draft a short migration guide with patterns for converting long-running examples into either: (a) mocked outputs, (b) shorter simulated examples, or (c) an async sample that shows non-blocking usage + a link to the full-run example in sample-apps. Will open PR. :+1:

Amanda: Example guidance to include in the docs (short):

```js
// JS SDK: set an explicit request timeout for long ops, or switch to background polling
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, timeout: 300000 }); // 5min for sample apps
// For inline docs keep snippets <5s or show mock output
```

```py
# Python SDK: prefer a non-blocking example in docs
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), timeout=5)  # inline examples: small timeout
# show async pattern and link to full sample in repo
```

Jon: Will update the docs PR checklist and the snippet linter message to call this out.

Amanda: CI rollout plan: snippet-checker toggled in staging next Tues, enforced in main on Wed (2026-04-01). Notify authors proactively.

Kai: Any guidance for transcripts/long streaming outputs?

Amanda: For streaming, suggest showing the handshake + first few tokens and then elide with "..." and link to sample-app. We'll add a template snippet for that.

Lina: Opening the migration PR now — will include a short section "How to handle long-running examples" + 3 concrete patterns.

Jon: :thumbsup: I'll add a short note to the docs contribution guide and the PR template.

Amanda: Thanks all. Ping me or @lina if you want to sync on wording.

docs-bot: Reminder: authors with failing snippets will receive an automated message with suggested fixes.

Amanda: Final: deploy to main on Wed. We'll circle back after one week to see if more adjustments needed.
